about: Proposed content blocks for curriculum v3.2 skills that use the theory generators (Engine API 1.5). Agreed shapes: messages 2026-11-20-2350 (Claude) and 2026-11-20-2357 (ChatGPT). This file is test data, not the curriculum: ChatGPT owns the curriculum and copies or changes these blocks there; the runtime swap waits for Kevin. tests/generators_node.js checks every block against its objective.
